title.suggested: Jem Mace Gives His Opinion of Tom Allen

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reprinted a Buffalo News interview with Jem Mace, who said he had come to America to fight Tom Allen but gave way to Joe Goss, and called the Allen-Goss fight evenly matched.

metadata.notes: Masthead: 'St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Friday Morning, July 28, 1876', page 8. Reprinted from the Buffalo News.

facts.fact: Jem Mace said he had come to America to fight Allen, but stood aside so that Joe Goss could fight him
Allen had been in training to fight George Rooke a short time before the Goss match was made

notes: Mostly Mace's views; Allen is discussed for part of the interview. The current title ('Tom Allen in Prize Fight') does not describe the article.
